## dry age status

Current dry-age duration: `r round(end_date - start_date, 1)` days

Starting weight: 14.2 lbs

Start date: `r format(start_date, "%Y-%m-%d")`

Target date: `r format(start_date + lubridate::days(45), "%Y-%m-%d")` (45 days)

```{r utils}
.dew_point <- function(temp_c, rh_pct) {
  stopifnot(length(temp_c) == length(rh_pct))
  a <- 17.625
  b <- 243.04

  x <- ((a * temp_c) / (b + temp_c)) + log(rh_pct / 100)

  return((b * x) / (a - x))
}
c_to_f <- function(temp_c) (temp_c * 9/5) + 32
f_to_c <- function(temp_f) (temp_f - 32) * 5/9
```

```{r parse}
readings <- list.files(path = here::here("logs"), full.names = TRUE) |>
  lapply(yyjsonr::read_ndjson_file) |>
  tibble::tibble() |>
  tidyr::unnest(1) |>
  dplyr::filter(timestamp >= start_date & timestamp <= end_date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    timestamp = lubridate::as_datetime(timestamp),
    temperature_f = c_to_f(temperature_c) |> round(2)
  )
```
## Cycle Analysis
```{r cycle_metrics}
cycle_metrics <- readings |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cycle_trend = ifelse(
      dplyr::lag(temperature_f, default = Inf) > temperature_f,
      "down",
      "up"
    ),
    cycle_num = dplyr::consecutive_id(cycle_trend)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cycle_duration = max(timestamp) - min(timestamp),
    .by = cycle_num
  ) |>
  # collapse cycles shorter than 90s with the previous cycle
  dplyr::mutate(
    cycle_trend = ifelse(
      cycle_duration <= lubridate::seconds(90),
      NA,
      cycle_trend
    ) |>
      vctrs::vec_fill_missing(direction = "down"),
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cycle_num = cumsum(
      cycle_trend != dplyr::lag(cycle_trend, default = "down") &
        cycle_trend == "down"
    )
  ) |>
  # recalculate new cycle durations
  dplyr::mutate(
    cycle_duration = max(timestamp) - min(timestamp),
    cycle_duration_up = max(timestamp[cycle_trend == "up"]) -
      min(timestamp[cycle_trend == "up"]),
    cycle_duration_down = max(timestamp[cycle_trend == "down"]) -
      min(timestamp[cycle_trend == "down"]),
    cycle_start_time = min(timestamp),
    cycle_trend = NULL,
    .by = cycle_num
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    cycle_num,
    starts_with("cycle"),
    temperature_f,
    humidity_pct,
    gas_ohms,
    pressure_hpa,
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -starts_with("cycle"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "raw_value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    .by = c(starts_with("cycle"), "metric"),
    mean = mean(raw_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantiles = quantile(
      raw_value,
      c(0.05, 0.20, 0.8, 0.95),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) |>
      round(2) |>
      setNames(c("p05", "p20", "p80", "p95")) |>
      as.list() |>
      list()
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_wider(quantiles) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c("mean", starts_with("p")),
    names_to = "metric_type",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric_type = forcats::fct_relevel(
      metric_type,
      "p05",
      "p20",
      "mean",
      "p80",
      "p95"
    ),
    value = round(value, 3)
  )
```

```{r plot_fn}
plot_cycle_metric <- function(
  metric_name,
  cycle_metrics,
  plot_title = NULL,
  plot_subtitle = NULL,
  plot_caption = NULL,
  timestamp_limits = NULL,
  timestamp_reference_lines = NULL,
  metric_units = NULL,
  metric_breaks_width = 1,
  metric_limits = NULL,
  metric_reference_lines = NULL,
  metric_types = c("p05", "p20", "mean", "p80", "p95")
) {
  d <- cycle_metrics |>
    dplyr::filter(metric_name == metric, metric_type %in% metric_types) |>
    dplyr::filter(cycle_num < max(cycle_num))

  suppressWarnings({
    p <- ggplot(aes(x = cycle_start_time, y = value), data = d) +
      purrr::compact(
        list(
          tantastic::theme_tantastic(
            base_size = 16,
            plot_title_size = 20,
            axis_title_size = 16,
            axis_text_size = 14,
            caption_size = 12
          ),
          geom_point(
            aes(y = value, color = metric_type),
            size = 0.5,
            alpha = 0.5
          ),
          if (!is.null(metric_reference_lines)) {
            geom_texthline(
              yintercept = metric_reference_lines$y,
              label = metric_reference_lines$label,
              color = "white",
              alpha = 0.8,
              linewidth = 0.5,
              hjust = 1,
              data = metric_reference_lines
            )
          },
          geom_textsmooth(
            aes(y = value, color = metric_type, label = metric_type),
            linewidth = 1,
            method = "loess",
            formula = y ~ x,
            alpha = 1,
            linewidth = 1.5,
            span = 0.1,
            hjust = 0.1,
            textcolor = "white",
            se = F
          ),
          if (!is.null(timestamp_reference_lines)) {
            geom_labelvline(
              xintercept = timestamp_reference_lines$timestamp,
              label = timestamp_reference_lines$label,
              color = "white",
              fill = "white",
              textcolor = "black",
              label.r = unit(0.05, "lines"),
              label.padding = unit(0.05, "lines"),
              alpha = 0.8,
              hjust = 0.05,
              linewidth = 0.5,
              linetype = 2,
              data = timestamp_reference_lines
            )
          },
          scale_y_continuous(
            limits = metric_limits,
            expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0.2, 0)),
            minor_breaks = scales::minor_breaks_width(metric_breaks_width, 0)
          ),
          scale_x_datetime(
            limits = timestamp_limits,
            expand = ggplot2::expansion(c(0.05, 0.1)),
            # minor_breaks = scales::minor_breaks_width("1 days", "0 day"),
            timezone = "America/Toronto"
          ),
          labs(
            title = plot_title,
            subtitle = plot_subtitle,
            caption = plot_caption,
            x = "Timestamp (America/Toronto)",
            y = metric_units
          ),
          theme(legend.position = "none")
        )
      )
  })
  return(p)
}
```
```{r table_fn}
table_cycle_metrics <- function(metric_name, n_digits) {
  cycle_metrics |>
    dplyr::filter(metric == metric_name, metric_type != "raw_value", cycle_num != max(cycle_num)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      metric_type = forcats::fct_relevel(
        metric_type,
        "p05",
        "p20",
        "mean",
        "p80",
        "p95"
      ),
      value = round(value, n_digits)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(metric_type) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = metric_type,
      values_from = value
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      cycle_start = lubridate::with_tz(cycle_start_time, "America/Toronto"),
      cycle_duration = lubridate::seconds_to_period(round(cycle_duration)),
      cycle_duration_up = lubridate::seconds_to_period(round(cycle_duration_up)),
      cycle_duration_down = lubridate::seconds_to_period(round(cycle_duration_down))
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      cycle_start,
      mean,
      p05,
      p20,
      p80,
      p95,
      cycle_duration,
      cycle_duration_up,
      cycle_duration_down,
    ) |>
    knitr::kable()
}
```
### Temperature

```{r plot_tempf}
plot_cycle_metric(
  metric_name = "temperature_f",
  cycle_metrics = cycle_metrics,
  plot_title = "Temperature",
  plot_subtitle = "Canadians do cooking in Fahrenheit ;)",
  metric_units = "degrees F",
  metric_limits = c(NA, 48),
  metric_reference_lines = data.frame(
    y = c(32, 34, 38, 40),
    label = c("freezing", "lower", "upper", "danger")
  ),
  timestamp_reference_lines = events
)

```

```{r table_temp}
table_cycle_metrics("temperature_f", n_digits = 2)

```
